Do you love turning menus and interfaces into something players actually enjoy clicking through, and want to own that from first sketch to final implementation? We’d love to talk to you.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game built around a beloved IP, with our own spin on it. A bold new direction for us! And we're just getting started.

Now, we’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to join a team of around 15-20 people and own the UI/UX for the entire game. You’ll be the first dedicated UI/UX designer on the team (and at Triband generally!), so you’ll shape the game’s interface aesthetic and logic as well as player experience from the ground up.

**Here’s What You’ll Do Day To Day

**

• Own the full UI/UX pipeline for the game: from flow, wireframes, and mockups through to final in-engine implementation (we use Unity)

• Design and build UI elements like menus, icons, HUDs, and input controls that are clear, playful, and true to the game’s tone

• Bake in accessibility design and settings from the start, not as an afterthought

• Create dynamic transitions and animations that make the UI feel alive

• Implement your own designs solidly in Unity (you won’t be just handing off mockups!)

• Collaborate closely with game designers and programmers to keep the UI consistent, technically sound, and fun to use

• Maintain a consistent visual language and set of UI standards as the game grows

**You’re probably a good match if

**

• You have solid experience owning UI/UX work end to end, from flow through to final implementation

• You have strong Unity implementation skills and are comfortable taking your own UI work all the way into engine

• You’re skilled in Illustrator

• You have experience mocking up interactive flows in a tool like Figma, Miro, or similar (any tool is fine)

• You genuinely enjoy working within an existing visual style rather than starting from a blank page every time

• You’ve shipped a mobile game before, including responsive/adaptive interfaces

• You have a strong eye for color, shapes, contrast, and readability

**Nice to have

**

• A passion for accessibility and usability, especially for family-friendly/casual audiences

• You see real value in user testing and what it can teach you

• An interest in motion design and UI animation

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**This project is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. What we also believe in:

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place.

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• This role is based in the Greater Copenhagen area, and we’re not considering people located outside of commuting distance for this one.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10–15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• A shot at shaping the interface of a live game played by millions

• A tight, collaborative team where your ideas actually make it into the game

• A playful work environment where trying the silly idea is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, and whatever else Tribanders turn into a tradition

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant, with plant-based options and soft ice on Thursdays

• Private health insurance paid by us

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Endless amounts of Noda

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make people laugh. We explore comedy through gameplay, which means we like to break player expectations, create surprising interactions, use great music and slick art, and build quirky worlds full of personality.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games. And we believe diversity makes teams better. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and who are excited to challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

**Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation

Who We Are

**NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. We are now building the team, and we are looking for a Data Science Student who wants to work at the heart of it.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of the analytical engine in the Strategy & Transformation Office. Every major decision in our transformation needs a solid fact base, and every initiative needs to show that it delivers. You will help build both, and your work will land directly with our CEO and Executive Management.

You are comfortable with code and data, and just as interested in what the numbers mean for the business. You are AI savvy, and you are curious about the bigger picture of how AI transforms organisations, ways of working and business models.

**Typical tasks include

**▪ Building the fact base behind OneNNIT 2030, from portfolio and revenue analysis to customer, market and capability data

▪ Designing and maintaining the KPIs, dashboards and benefit tracking that show Executive Management and the Board how the transformation is progressing

▪ Modelling revenue, margin and demand across offerings and geographies as we consolidate our portfolio into value pathways

▪ Combining data from finance, sales, delivery and HR systems into analyses that inform strategic decisions

▪ Identifying, sizing and prioritising AI use cases across our offerings, delivery model and internal processes, and tracking AI adoption across NNIT

▪ Building prototypes and analytical tools in Python, SQL or Power BI, and using generative AI to work faster and smarter

▪ Turning analysis into clear insights and material for workshops, leadership meetings and strategy sessions

**What You Will Bring

****We imagine that you

**▪ Are preferably in the third year of your Bachelor's degree, or in the first year of your Master’s degree, for example in Business ▪ Administration and Data Science or Digital Management at Copenhagen Business School

▪ Have a strong interest in data science, AI, strategy and business transformation

▪ Are curious about how data and AI change decisions, organisations and value creation

▪ Are analytical and structured, and able to turn complex data into clear insights that non-specialists can act on

▪ Have hands-on experience with Python and SQL, and with Power BI or a similar tool, alongside strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

▪ Communicate clearly and professionally in Danish and English, both written and spoken

▪ Take initiative, have a strong eye for quality, handle confidential information with discretion and enjoy working with senior stakeholders

**What We Offer

**You will join the Strategy & Transformation Office, which reports directly to the CEO, and work closely with the Head of Strategy & Transformation. You will have a front-row seat as NNIT redefines its strategy, organisation and portfolio, and you will work alongside Executive Management, senior leaders across Europe, the US and Asia, and our external advisors.

You will get real responsibility from day one, high exposure to senior leadership and the flexibility to balance work with your studies. Few student jobs offer a closer view of how strategy and transformation are done in practice.

**Practical Information

**The role is 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Please upload your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.

**About NNIT

**NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

You’ll gain hands-on experience and insight into the energy markets that go beyond what you learn in the classroom. Along the way, you’ll help create solutions that enable our customers to grow their businesses.

Here’s what the job entails

As our new Junior Commercial Asset Manager, you will support our Commercial Asset Management and Origination teams, with a particular focus on Italian customers within renewables assets. You will contribute to a variety of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience with the European energy markets. A key part of the role is also to engage with stakeholders, build relations and navigate across the entire organisation.

Furthermore, your responsibilities include:

• handling contract management and preparing tender and sales material

• joining customer meetings and contributing to solutions that support customer growth

• supporting planning, execution, and participation of commercial events, conferences and fairs

• collaborating closely with middle and back-office teams

• driving and participating in internal projects

The position is based in Copenhagen, alternatively Aarhus.

Meet your team

You will join our Commercial Asset Management team, dedicated to optimising Danske Commodities’ customer-related activities in Europe. The team collaborates closely with our Origination sales team to grow our customer business by for instance drafting contracts, managing tender processes and driving business development.

We share a deep understanding of energy markets and what our customers need. We keep an informal tone, and we believe teamwork is key to success. As a diverse team of market specialists across various European offices, nationalities and backgrounds, we bring together different perspectives to create real impact.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will work on a variety of tasks and collaborate with different people across the organisation, we imagine that you are curious, structured and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You enjoy working with others and find energy in supporting customers and colleagues.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• are enrolled in a relevant education within Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Energy Economics or similar

• are curious about energy markets and motivated to learn more

• can work approximately 15-20 hours a week

• are proficient in Italian and English – both written and spoken. If you speak any additional languages, we would love to hear about them

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life to fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick days because family comes first

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Worklinq is looking for an energetic and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition and accelerate our growth in the HR tech B2B SaaS market. In this role, you will be at the forefront of expanding our market presence, managing end-to-end sales processes from qualified opportunities through to closed contracts, and building strong relationships with enterprise decision-makers. You will work closely with multiple internal functions, including marketing, sales development and delivery, to turn commercial opportunities into long-term customers.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-end sales: Drive deals through the full cycle, from qualified meetings and solution demonstrations to final negotiation and signing.

• Modern sales execution: Use modern sales and AI tools to streamline prospect research, elevate message quality, and shorten sales cycles.

• Pipeline creation: Prospect into target enterprise accounts via outbound outreach, supplemented by handling qualified inbound leads.

• Commercial collaboration: Partner with marketing and delivery teams to ensure strong lead conversion and seamless handovers to customer onboarding.

• Pipeline hygiene & forecasting: Maintain structured CRM data, clear next steps, and realistic revenue forecasting for all active opportunities.

Professional qualifications

• Tool & AI fluency: Experience with structured CRM workflows and an active, competent approach to using AI tools for day-to-day productivity and research.

• Track record in B2B SaaS: Experience running and closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.

• Consultative selling: Ability to navigate enterprise buying committees, uncover business pain points, and articulate software value.

• Contract & negotiation skills: Hands-on experience structuring commercial proposals and negotiating contracts with decision-makers.

Personal qualifications

• High drive & grit, motivated by target achievement, disciplined, and resilient through longer sales cycles.

• Strong communicator, capable of establishing trust, active listening, and clear communication with executive stakeholders.

• Proactive mindset with a high sense of ownership over your own pipeline and results.

• Curious & collaborative, quick to grasp complex industry workflows and eager to contribute to team learning.

• Enjoys working across teams, bringing together diverse expertise, including professional services, to create momentum and drive successful outcomes throughout the customer journey.

What we offer

Worklinq is in the midst of an exciting transformation, taking our Workforce Management platform forward as a modern cloud-based SaaS solution for large enterprises across the Nordics and Europe.

To succeed on this journey, we build our culture around four core values: Customer-centric, United, Transparent, and Innovative, which guide how we treat each other, our customers, and our partners every day.

From our headquarters in Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues in Sweden, Norway, the UK, and Romania. We have an informal tone, flat decision-making structures, and a collaborative team spirit. We know that strong results begin with people who thrive and grow. That is why we prioritise professional knowledge-sharing, a strong sense of community, and social gatherings both locally and across borders once or twice a year.

Ready to make an impact?

In this role, you will be part of a five-person Sales and Marketing team, reporting directly to the CCO.

Curious about the role, our culture, or how we hire? We’d love to chat. Reach out to Head of People & Culture Anne Heiberg, ah@worklinq.com.

_**About The Job

**Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

**Your profile

**

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments

**Nice To Have

**

• Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We get curious people invested in the world

We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• 
Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• 
Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• 
Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• 
Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• 
Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• 
Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• 
Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• 
Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• 
Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• 
Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• 
Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• 
Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• 
Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• 
Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• 
Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• 
Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 
2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• 
A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• 
Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• 
A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• 
Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• 
Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• 
Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• 
Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• 
Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• 
Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• 
Competitive salary + company paid pension

• 
DSB Business Card

• 
Private health insurance

• 
Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• 
Lunch subsidized by the company

• 
Company phone and company credit card

• 
Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a student assistant with a data science background to support our business functions with automation and data management

• 
Type: Part-time student position

• 
Hours: 10 to 15 hours per week, planned around your studies

• 
Compensation: Hourly wage according to qualifications

• 
Location: Frederiksberg

• 
Start date: February 1 (flexible)

• 
Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Do you want to apply your data science skills to real business problems in a deep-tech scale-up?

As Sparrow Quantum grows, so does the data behind the business: customer and supplier records, orders, finance figures, and hiring data spread across spreadsheets and systems. We are looking for a student assistant to bring order to that data and automate the work around it, in close collaboration with finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing.

To be clear about the scope: this is applied data work for business functions, not machine learning research. Your hours will be split evenly between data management and automation on one side, and business support across the company on the other.

Data management

• 
Clean and maintain business data across finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing

• 
Support on developing data flows between our systems, so the same data is not entered twice

• 
Maintain data quality checks, naming conventions and documentation, and keep them up to date

• 
Support maintaining dashboards and reports that give management and teams an up-to-date view of key figures, in tools such as Power BI and Excel

Automation

• 
Support on mapping recurring manual processes and propose which to automate first

• 
Help build and maintain automations in Python or other tools, and with tools such as Microsoft 365

• 
Use AI tools, including large language models, to speed up data handling and reporting, within our rules for confidential information

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

**What You Will Do

**You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

**How We Work

**You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant – Actuarial Services, Financial Services Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG
